carried.thesis: Cys467 is a quasi-catalytic substrate-pocket cysteine (C467A raises Gln Km ~10x) that the nearest paralogs (SLC1A4 Thr, EAATs Arg) lack, so a covalent warhead is intrinsically paralog-selective and gives washout-resistant transport blockade reversible competitors cannot achieve against high intracellular glutamine — genuine open white space, capped by unproven human target validation.

Cys249 in LBD helix 3 is a structurally de-risked, selective covalent handle (proven by tool compound GSK3787) homologous to the heavily-drugged PPARG Cys313, so the validated PPARG covalent inverse-agonist playbook (Flare FX-909) can be ported to lock PPARD in a corepressor state for oncology — mechanism proven at tool-compound level but no drug-like clinical program exists.

Cys424 sits where most kinases carry a His in the catalytic/HRD region — an isoform-distinguishing, active-site-proximal cysteine that could finally deliver the PKC-isoform selectivity that sank pan-PKC agents (sotrastaurin), giving durable T-cell-restricted immunosuppression; covalent space is open but warhead druggability of Cys424 is unconfirmed.

Cys298 is a highly nucleophilic active-site-adjacent cysteine that physiologically governs both catalysis and inhibitor sensitivity (C298S raises sorbinil Ki ~10x), with direct family precedent for warhead capture (PGA1 at AKR1B10 Cys299), so covalent durability could overcome the low-potency/PK failure mode of reversible ARIs — but AKR1B1>AKR1B10 selectivity and the fact that failures were efficacy/translation (not potency) cap conviction.

YES1 is one of only 3 SRC-family kinases bearing a P-loop cysteine (Cys277, nM-validated covalently by Taunton-lab probes) giving a rare selectivity handle vs ~500 kinases and durable occupancy at low exposure for YES1-amplified NSCLC/SCLC/TNBC — but C277 is shared with SRC/FGR (no intra-SFK selectivity from warhead alone) and a differentiated reversible incumbent (NXP900) is already in Phase 1b.

Covalent capture of a gamma-unique cysteine is the literature-nominated way to break the conserved-ATP-pocket problem that defeated every reversible PKC program, and the covalent space is open — but the linchpin (a specific, ligandable, gamma-UNIQUE cysteine) is unconfirmed by primary structural/chemoproteomic data, making this the most contingent lane.

covalent pan-RAF on conserved hinge Cys C424 (=BRAF C532); NO covalent RAF in clinic; answers V600E negative-allostery/dimer escape. Risks: directed-engagement unproven (computational only); conserved-Cys wild-type tox ceiling.
undrugged MM-Achilles-heel TF; C194 ligandable (4 datasets) but silent linker -> enter as covalent degrader; no covalent program (vs dIRF4-2 PROTAC + Ionis ASO).
